g.text: KE-Texh / TAMARAW — PHASE-1 SHELL — FABRICATOR DISCUSSION PACK
PRELIMINARY — VERIFY ON VEHICLE — NOT LTO-CERTIFIED
NO-GO CUT STEEL UNTIL THE GATES BELOW ARE SIGNED
PROTOTYPE ONLY · RENDERS ≠ FARM-READY · NOT LTO
OAH ≤ 2500 = HATCH CLOSED. NO SECOND OAL.
Verify VIN and as-found tape before any cut.
Wall ladder mounts, not a lift
GATES — UNSIGNED · NO-GO CUT UNTIL AS-FOUND + JAY GO + D-01…D-06
Bed, rails, cab roof, overhangs, VIN. Freeze on a shop traveler.
D-01 signed. No undirected drill into the bed rail or chassis rail.
D-01 and D-02. Placard stays blank until a post-weigh.
D-03 at the extension joint. FAIL-IF wet cabin, trapped water, wet glands.
D-04. FAIL-IF open cut with no seal, no rail, water in lounge, hatch open on road.
D-05. Roof access only. FAIL-IF used as a lift, or mounts loosen.
D-06. FAIL-IF trapped water under the tail, or wet glands at the bumper.
OAH ≤ 2500 means hatch closed. Renders are not farm-ready. Not LTO.
CLEAR H 1900–2000 IS A TARGET. IT IS NOT CLOSED BY SHELL EXT H ≈ 1830.
I-00 DRAWING INDEX, SoR, AND RELEASE STAMP
PRELIMINARY — VERIFY ON VEHICLE — NOT LTO-CERTIFIED
GATES: AS-FOUND · JAY GO RAIL DRILL · OUTRIGGERS+LEGS+kg · HOSE/RAIN · HATCH · LADDER · BUMPER/SPLASH · D-01…D-06 · PROTOTYPE ONLY
REV CONDITIONAL · DISCUSSION ONLY · NO-GO CUT STEEL UNTIL GATES · mm · 2026-09-23 · SHEET 1 OF 15
